item.title: Pavement. Castle Street, Winchcombe, 15th July
item.description:
This part of the pavement at the upper end of Castle Street, Winchcombe has been getting much worse over the years. The poor surface slopes markedly towards the road and is VERY difficuly to walk on especially for the many elderly residents.

item.description:
